description: This file defines abstract classes and properties related to file handling within a language model framework, including configurations, file endpoints, and methods for transforming requests and responses pertaining to file operations.

classes.name: BaseFilesConfig
classes.description: An abstract configuration class for managing file-related settings and behaviors in the LLM ecosystem, including methods for URL construction and request/response transformation.

classes.name: BaseFileEndpoints
classes.description: An abstract class defining the asynchronous interface for file operations such as create, retrieve, list, delete, and content retrieval, intended for implementation with specific backend services.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Abstract property to specify the LLM provider.

methods.name: str file_upload_http_method(self)
methods.description: Property returning the HTTP method used for file uploads, defaulting to POST.

methods.name: List[OpenAICreateFileRequestOptionalParams] get_supported_openai_params( self, model: str )
methods.description: Abstract method to get supported OpenAI file creation parameters based on the model.

methods.name: get_complete_file_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, data: CreateFileRequest, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete URL for file operations based on various parameters.

methods.name: Union[dict,str,bytes] transform_create_file_request( self, model: str, create_file_data: CreateFileRequest, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to transform the create file request data.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject transform_create_file_response( self, model: Optional[str], raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process and transform the response from file creation.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Method intended to transform request data; default raises NotImplementedError for specific models.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Method intended to transform response data; default raises NotImplementedError for specific models.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject acreate_file( self, create_file_request: CreateFileRequest, llm_router: Router, target_model_names_list: List[str], litellm_parent_otel_span: Span, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Abstract async method to create a file with given request data.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject afile_retrieve( self, file_id: str, litellm_parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], )
methods.description: Abstract async method to retrieve a file by its ID.

methods.name: List[OpenAIFileObject] afile_list( self, purpose: Optional[OpenAIFilesPurpose], litellm_parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], **data: Dict, )
methods.description: Abstract async method to list files, optionally filtered by purpose.

methods.name: OpenAIFileObject afile_delete( self, file_id: str, litellm_parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], llm_router: Router, **data: Dict, )
methods.description: Abstract async method to delete a file by its ID.

methods.name: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent" afile_content( self, file_id: str, litellm_parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], llm_router: Router, **data: Dict, )
methods.description: Abstract async method to retrieve the content of a file.
